title: A 10-Year-Old Acquisition Is Finally Paying off Big for Walmart. Should Amazon Investors Be Worried?
title_zh: 历时十年的收购终于为沃尔玛带来丰厚回报。亚马逊投资者应该担心吗？
summary: Walmart's "failed" Jet.com deal quietly built the foundation for a $150 billion e-commerce engine that's now closing the gap with Amazon.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛“失败”的 Jet.com 交易悄然为价值 1500 亿美元的电子商务引擎奠定了基础，该引擎目前正在缩小与亚马逊的差距。

title: Canadian quantum firm Xanadu debuts on public markets after SPAC deal
title_zh: SPAC 交易后，加拿大量子公司 Xanadu 在公开市场首次亮相
summary: Xanadu targets fully fault-tolerant quantum computing, with near-term revenue expected from run time sales and PennyLane software.
summary_zh: Xanadu 的目标是完全容错的量子计算，近期收入预计来自运行时销售和 PennyLane 软件。

title: Inside ‘Project Eagle,’ JPMorgan’s high-wire act to fund EA deal
title_zh: 摩根大通为 EA 交易提供资金的走钢丝行为“鹰计划”
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The post from @realDonaldTrump landed at precisely 7:23 a.m.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——@realDonaldTrump 的帖子于上午 7 点 23 分准时到达。

title: How Investors Are Reacting To KKR (KKR) Record Fundraising, Arctos Deal And New Platform Push
title_zh: 投资者对 KKR (KKR) 创纪录的融资、Arctos 交易和新平台推动有何反应
summary: Earlier this week, KKR outlined its expansion plans at the RBC Capital Markets Global Financial Institutions Conference 2026, highlighting a record US$129.00 billion raised in 2025, growth initiatives across new investment sectors, and its acquisition of Arctos to deepen expos...
summary_zh: 本周早些时候，KKR 在 2026 年加拿大皇家银行资本市场全球金融机构会议上概述了其扩张计划，强调了 2025 年筹集的创纪录的 1,290 亿美元、跨新投资领域的增长举措，以及收购 Arctos 以加深曝光……

title: Assessing Veritone (VERI) Valuation After Oracle Cloud Deal And AI Privacy Platform Updates
title_zh: Oracle 云交易和 AI 隐私平台更新后评估 Veritone (VERI) 估值
summary: Veritone (VERI) has drawn fresh attention after a multi year agreement with Oracle to migrate its AI solutions to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, along with updates to its privacy focused Redact and Data Refinery platforms. See our latest analysis for Veritone.
summary_zh: Veritone (VERI) 与 Oracle 达成多年协议，将其人工智能解决方案迁移到 Oracle 云基础设施，并更新了其专注于隐私的 Redact 和 Data Refinery 平台，之后引起了新的关注。请参阅我们对 Veritone 的最新分析。
